strategyTaxonomy.operatorSummary: Widens into the core universe, lowers cash, and keeps a starter-basket score bias.

reasonCodes.label: Starts from the pinned AI Infra basket membership.
Selects names from the core universe.
Applies a 12% score boost to starter-basket names inside broader selection.
Ranks names by baseline signal score.
Weights names with the signal score proportional curve.
Raises ranking scores to the 1x power before weights are normalized.
Keeps 5% in the AUSD yield buffer.
Only rebalances after 325 bps of drift.

summaries.construction: 95% stays in xStocks across 5 names. 5% remains in AUSD. Largest sleeves: NVDAx 22%, AMDx 19.79%, AVGOx 19.01%.
summaries.benchmark: After estimated costs, the pinned run delivered 51.08% versus 19.84% for basket.sp500_core_v1, an excess of +31.24%.
summaries.rebalance: Rebalance only when drift clears 325 bps. Current frozen-model assumptions imply 95% turnover and 43.25 bps total costs with 5% parked in AUSD.
summaries.operator: Core Low Cash Anchored keeps 95% in xStocks across 5 core universe names anchored to AI Infra, with 5% in AUSD. Top sleeves: NVDAx 22%, AMDx 19.79%, AVGOx 19.01%. Change from slot baseline: Selection universe: starter basket only -> core universe; Starter-basket bias: 0% -> 12%; Cash sleeve: 8% AUSD -> 5% AUSD. After estimated costs, the pinned run delivered 51.08% versus 19.84% for basket.sp500_core_v1, an excess of +31.24%.

currentKnobs.label: Candidate family
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Widens into the core universe, lowers cash, and keeps a starter-basket score bias.

currentKnobs.label: Starter basket
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes basket membership before weights are assigned.

currentKnobs.label: Selection universe
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Widens the eligible pool beyond the starter basket without changing slot identity.

currentKnobs.label: Holdings breadth
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes how many names survive ranking into the target basket.

currentKnobs.label: Starter anchor bias
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Keeps the slot anchored to its starter basket even when broader selection is enabled.

currentKnobs.label: Ranking signal
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes which names rise or fall inside the current basket.

currentKnobs.label: Weighting curve
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes how aggressively higher-ranked names dominate the basket.

currentKnobs.label: Signal power
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Makes the weighting curve flatter or more conviction-heavy without changing the underlying signal.

currentKnobs.label: Cash sleeve
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes how much capital stays in AUSD instead of xStocks exposure.

currentKnobs.label: Single-name cap
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Limits the maximum weight of one name.

currentKnobs.label: Rebalance trigger
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Skips smaller drifts to reduce churn.

watchpoints: NVDAx is the largest sleeve at 22% against a 22% single-name cap.
Frozen turnover is 95% with 43.25 bps of estimated total costs.
5 names are selected from the core universe.
Benchmark edge after costs is 31.24% versus basket.sp500_core_v1.
